description: A design pattern is a reusable idea for arranging code. It is not code you must copy everywhere. We will compare small JavaScript examples and learn when each idea helps. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise facades offer a small doorway

seo.title: Design Patterns Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Design Patterns with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
